The ATP2 comparison concerns growth curves and doubling time, not MIC or clinical susceptibility categories. Clone-level MIC data are supplied separately in Supplementary Table S4; they are not isolated allele-effect measurements.

discussion.notes: Reference taxonomy from UniProt: NCBITaxon:559292 is the S288c reference strain, within Saccharomyces cerevisiae (NCBITaxon:4932). Neither identifier establishes an exact tested derivative or genome. No resistance claim, subject accession, numeric AST or exact variant is added by this discussion. Source-owned claims and whole-record review status are unchanged.
discussion.prompt: Reconcile the ATP1/ATP2 CARD assertions with exact source-row, experimental-background and endpoint evidence before assigning tested alleles or interpreting target alteration mechanistically.
discussion.rationale: Taylor et al. (2022) report ATP1/ATP2 changes in evolved multi-gene laboratory yeast backgrounds. Their tested ATP2 single mutants grew more slowly than the wild-type comparator in the reported growth analysis. Combination effects depend on background and condition; this is neither proof of a standalone ATP2 resistance effect nor evidence against every ATP2 allele. The exact FungAMR-row crosswalk to this independently identified study remains unresolved. Retain the CARD assertions as database provenance, not a newly verified direct ATP-synthase drug target.

event.changes: Added an evidence-backed ATP1/ATP2 scope discussion retaining negative and conditional laboratory growth findings. Preserved all four CARD assertions and SEEDED review status. UniProt entries remain reference-only; no experimental allele, genome or new resistance claim assigned.
